title: A New Year’s resolve: For climate and Maryland
summary: With the General Assembly set to start next week, environmental groups are holding a seminar on upcoming bills and topics. Weighty stuff, but in the holiday spirit, Jennifer Laszlo Mizrahi extends an invitation to attend in rhyme.
content:
by Jennifer Laszlo Mizrahi, Maryland Matters January 1, 2025

by Jennifer Laszlo Mizrahi, Maryland Matters January 1, 2025

At the dawn of the year, with hope in the air,
Marylanders dreamed of a future so fair.
Clean energy goals, bold and bright,
Guided our hearts through the year’s first light.

While visions of forests and bays danced around,
The Chesapeake called us with beauty profound.
With love for our neighbors, for nature so dear,
We resolved to protect it this promising year.

But hark! On the horizon, a troubling fight,
Threats to our progress loomed big in the night.
The climate, at risk from destructive delay,
Needed bold action without further sway.

Then what to our wondering eyes should appear,
A summit to launch our resolve this year!
The 6th Annual Legislative Summit for Climate and Environment,
A free two-day online event—what excitement it sent!

January 4th and 5th, 2025, the dates to save,
A chance for Marylanders to be bold and brave.
“Join us!” they called, “From the comfort of home,
Learn how to advocate—no need to roam.

With captioning provided, it’s easy for all,
An invitation for action, a rallying call!”
From policies and training to tools you’ll retain,
This summit equips you to lead and sustain.

“Now RENEW Act, now Better Buildings, now coal harms to mend!
On Transparency! Ratepayer fairness to defend!
To cleaner transportation, to net-zero goals!
Onward to futures where green progress rolls!”

Workshops and sessions to sharpen your voice,
Guiding your passion, your purpose, your choice.
From speaking at hearings to crafting a plan,
This summit empowers every woman and man.

No action’s too small; your role is immense—
Each letter, each call, makes a difference.
Civic engagement, the heart of our fight,
Turns care into power to champion what’s right.

Cleaner air, better jobs, and energy savings,
Public health benefits, the future we’re craving.
This is Maryland’s moment—so rise to the call,
Your voice can make progress for one and for all.

So, this New Year, resolve to engage,
To protect our future, to turn a new page.
Sign up for the summit, take action today,
Together, for Maryland, we’ll lead the way.

To neighbors, to forests, to bays wide and free,
This fight is for all—and for you and for me.
So, Happy New Year! Let’s turn love into might,
And fight for our future with all of our light!
